items.brief: Proposed 31.4% French tax on regulated stablecoins could drive crypto traders offshore
items.why: High taxes on regulated stablecoins may push activity into unmonitored channels, affecting tokenized stablecoin adoption.

items.brief: BNY, Citadel Securities test tokenized U.S. Treasuries to speed up Wall Street financing
items.why: Tokenized Treasuries could enable faster collateral movement between settlement and financing.

items.brief: Most tokenized stock trading on Solana, BNB Chain occurs outside US market hours
items.why: Shows tokenized equities offering round-the-clock access beyond Wall Street hours.

items.brief: DRW and Marex complete OTC swap referencing tokenized S&P iBoxx Index
items.why: Demonstrates first OTC swap referencing a fully tokenized index on a blockchain network.

items.brief: Federated Hermes plans first onchain fund shares with Prometheum
items.why: Asset manager joining tokenization push to bring blockchain-based share classes to brokerage accounts.
